usedFor: OnceHub takes your meeting bookings and Pipeline CRM holds your people, so “Booking Scheduled” runs “Create Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Scheduled” in OnceHub, then “Create Person” in Pipeline CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each booked prospect becomes a person in Pipeline CRM before the call happens.

watchOut: “Booking Scheduled” runs for every booking, so a returning person can be added again by “Create Person”.
